definitions.explanation: A count of five people, using the Sino-Japanese number {五|ご} with the counter {人|にん}.

examples.japanese: このチームは{五人|ごにん}で{活動|かつどう}している。
examples.english: This team operates with five members.

examples.japanese: {応募者|おうぼしゃ}{五十人|ごじゅうにん}の{中|なか}から、{最終|さいしゅう}{選考|せんこう}に{残|のこ}ったのは{五人|ごにん}だけだった。
examples.english: Out of fifty applicants, only five made it to the final round.

notes:
{五|ご} plus the counter {人|にん} for people. The reading is regular, unlike {一人|ひとり}, {二人|ふたり}, and {四人|よにん}.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {五人|ごにん}で: as a group of five
- {五人|ごにん}{家族|かぞく}: a family of five
- {五人|ごにん}{兄弟|きょうだい}: five siblings
- {五人|ごにん}{組|ぐみ}: a group of five

CULTURAL NOTE:
{五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし} refers to the five musicians on the third tier of a {雛|ひな}{人形|にんぎょう} doll display for the Doll Festival.

RELATED COUNTS:
- {四人|よにん}: four people
- {六人|ろくにん}: six people
